parameters.excerpt: For each bit in 61:58, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Whether each privilege mode filtering bit (SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mcyclecfg/minstretcfg is writable depends on whether the associated privilege mode is implemented. Unimplemented modes have read-only-zero bits.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: When all xINH bits are zero, event counting is enabled in all modes.
